big_case.notes: Although the underlying Payment Card Interchange Fee MDL involves a $5.6 billion settlement fund and petitioner invokes the post-TransUnion/Labcorp class-standing debate, this specific petition is a single objector's post-judgment challenge to an unpublished Second Circuit summary order construing contract language ('accepted') in a final 2019 settlement agreement without reaching any statutory-standing or Article III issue. Both respondents waived response, zero amici filed, no response was called for, and the Court summarily denied certiorari at the first conference (Nov. 16, 2026, Justice Alito taking no part) with no noted dissents.
